title: Prove the sharp rounded dyadic connector carry (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof with exact finite corroboration. Answer the rounded-child question left by Hanson Sun / bbMisk in PR1526 for its two dyadic conjugations and displayed B0 repair.

```text
refined H B D: z -> z + Q_h(2 Bx), sharp error h/2
complete B0 repair: z_final - z_initial = Q_h(2 Bx) - 2 Q_h(Bx)
                                                   in {-h, 0, h}
```

Here Q_h(t)=h floor(t/h+1/2), scales are exact, and signed queries apply their sign after rounding. One additional root fractional bit halves the local source-query error, but can break the complete dirty-root boundary. All three residual values occur. Coarse rounding preserves cancellation; a final ternary correction also restores the root and requires its own paid implementation. The output conjugation D A H has sharp h/2 error and restores its root.

The new result was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Hanson Sun / bbMisk for PR1526's exact word and question, Ross Richardson / PR944, martinxxx9 / PR1088 and the retained signed-connector lineage. The predecessor optimum is cited, not replayed. Classical nearest rounding is not claimed new. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Evidence

- Before: the exact-arithmetic conjugations have no rounded-child guarantee. The explicit refined extension leaves root error 1 at h=1, B0=1/8, x0=3.
- After: the written proof gives the exact residual formula, its complete three-interval classification, sharp local bounds and two root-boundary repairs. The verifier enumerates 3,402 source intervals, 1,050 output intervals, 102 complete rounded-word fixtures and eight controls. Full literal inverses pass.
- CPython 3.12.15, Darwin arm64. Both registered commands passed locally, timed separately at 0.099 s normal and 0.105 s optimized. These are check durations, not a speedup claim. The registered runner passed in 0.580 s. Later metadata-only source-head recording changes receipt hashes but no scientific code; the final committed package replay also passed.
- Committed bytes/source history pass for seven files. Official export integrity and its one declared input pass. Normal and optimized read-only Git-free export runs pass with empty PATH. An actual corrupted source export is rejected. Receipts are generated from execution and bind all six package file hashes.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rounded-dyadic-conjugation
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/rounded-dyadic-conjugation/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/rounded-dyadic-conjugation/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/rounded-dyadic-conjugation --check-source-history
```

Other machines can replace the interpreter path with their CPython 3.12 executable. No dependencies beyond the standard library are required. Direct success marker: `PASS_ROUNDED_DYADIC_CONJUGATION`; registered success marker: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

## Limitations

This is one specified deterministic additive rounding contract and one displayed B0 repair. Exact H/D, source independence, tie handling and the literal inverse convention are hypotheses. A complete connector output-error budget, actual recursive/native child, correction evaluation/delivery cost, physical invoice, compiler, stock, precision/tape and outer recovery remain unproved. No selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, native admission, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. All five selected framework assumptions remain.

## Open next questions

- Price a native B child and the source-only ternary repair, including both root scans, coefficient evaluation, routing and restoration. Determine whether the removed-child allowance survives.
- Propagate the repaired word's complete output errors under a specified native norm and caller allowance. Root restoration and a local radius do not supply that budget.

## Related open work

The completion refresh inspected all 112 account open PRs, including fifteen created since the advance CLAIM and fourteen other than this PR. None reports a competing value for PR1526's rounded B0 repair or its root-carry quantity. No additional scientific computations checked those contributions.

- [PR6561](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6561) proves equivariant rounding radii for integer frame groups. Its simultaneous group-equivariance contract differs from this fixed scalar query and dirty-root restoration contract; no competing value for either contract is computed here.
- [PR6566](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6566) proves read-set dominance for exact joint connector synthesis. Its binary search-state and read-cost quantities differ from this deterministic rounded dyadic carry.
- [PR6568](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6568) constructs exact unsigned finite-characteristic connector words from balanced closed walks. It does not study rounded root carries or this characteristic-zero signed B0 repair.

PR1556's merged unit-phase tariff and PR1770's merged binary five-source invoice concern different exact interfaces. Sparse notes, unpublished work and arbitrary historical diffs remain overlap limits.

[Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19370233). Canonical base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; source PR1526 head: `1fb85dc6813b88483f4f0a359ccd722376acd292`.

**Blast Radius:** package.

Only the isolated research package is added. It registers two bounded verification commands and one immutable predecessor README input.
